backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor managing access control, user profiles, stats, availability, chat, and daily logs with helper modules and availability query functions.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report structure with kind set to feature_evidence_report.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing prewritten summaries for all frontend source files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light and dark theme design tokens and base styles.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app with routing, authentication gate, profile setup logic, and route definitions for all pages.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: Admin-only access denial screen with warning icon and link back to calendar.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginScreen: Login screen with branded card, background image, and Internet Identity sign‑in button.
frontend/src/components/branding/AppLogo: Simple component rendering the app logo from branding config.
frontend/src/components/chat/ChatPanel.t: Interactive group chat panel with message list, user avatars, scrolling, and message sending.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Layout wrapper providing top bar, navigation, main content area, and footer attribution.
frontend/src/components/layout/Navigatio: Renders a bottom navigation bar with dynamic active state and an optional admin link based on user role.
frontend/src/components/layout/TopBar.ts: Displays the top header with logo, theme toggle, user avatar, and logout handling.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileC: Shows and edits the user's profile info, including name and profile picture upload with progress.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileL: Fetches weekly, monthly, and all‑time leaderboards and displays the caller’s ranks with loading states.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileM: Displays the caller’s match history with wins/losses per day and handles loading and empty states.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: A modal prompting new users to enter their name and save their initial profile.
frontend/src/components/theme/Background: Wraps content with a fixed low‑opacity background image.
Displays a user avatar with initials fallback and their name, supporting sizes and loading state.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refreshing dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Provides hooks to fetch and update the caller’s user profile with React Query integration.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserRole.ts: Provides hooks to fetch the caller’s role and admin status from the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication using AuthClient, including login, logout, and stored identity loading.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, availability data, leaderboards, and match history from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Manages light/dark theme state with localStorage persistence and toggling support.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserDirectory.ts: Fetches user display names and avatar data for a list of principals, with helpers for directory lookups and display-name retrieval.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind setup defining light and dark theme CSS variables and global styles.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Exports centralized branding constants including app name and logo URLs.
frontend/src/lib/date.ts: Utility functions for converting dates to day IDs, formatting dates/times, generating month grids, and timeframe calculations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AddAvailabilityPage.t: Page allowing users to add or edit availability for a specific day with time selection, notes, and submission handling.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin panel for managing registered users and their availabilities, including deletion actions and sorted display tables.
frontend/src/pages/CalendarMonthPage.tsx: Renders a monthly calendar grid showing which days have availability and links to day details.
frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.tsx: Simple page wrapping the group chat panel with a header.
frontend/src/pages/DayDetailPage.tsx: Displays availability details for a specific day with options to add, edit, or delete the caller’s availability.
frontend/src/pages/LeaderboardPage.tsx: Shows leaderboard rankings across timeframes and allows recording or removing daily wins and losses.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: User profile page showing personal info, leaderboard ranks, and recent match history.
frontend/src/utils/file.ts: Utility for converting files to Uint8Array and generating name initials.
frontend/src/utils/time.ts: Utility functions for time selection, formatting, and parsing availability time strings.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and syncing between URL and stored values, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, typography, container queries, animations, and theme extensions.
project_state.json: Defines project state and feature requests focused on fixing leaderboard timeframe filtering using integer day comparisons.
